description: Source code implementing Vulkan tensor packing and conversion functions for the ATen library, including shader selection and command recording for tensor format conversions.

classes.name: ToFromTextureParams
classes.description: Struct holding parameters for texture conversion operations.

methods.name: get_nchw_to_image_shader
methods.description: Selects the appropriate shader info for converting NCHW tensor to image format based on quantization, dtype, and storage type.

methods.name: get_image_to_nchw_shader
methods.description: Selects the shader info for converting image format back to NCHW tensor based on quantization, dtype, and storage type.

methods.name: record_nchw_to_image_op
methods.description: Records a Vulkan compute operation to convert a tensor from NCHW format to image format.

methods.name: record_image_to_nchw_op
methods.description: Records a Vulkan compute operation to convert an image format tensor back to NCHW format.

methods.name: record_nchw_to_buffer_op
methods.description: Records a Vulkan compute operation to convert a tensor from NCHW format to a buffer.

methods.name: record_buffer_to_nchw_op
methods.description: Records a Vulkan compute operation to convert a buffer to an NCHW tensor.

methods.name: channel_image_repacking
methods.description: Rearranges tensor channels into a different memory layout using a compute shader.

methods.name: convert_image_channels_packed_to_height_packed
methods.description: Converts image tensor channels to height-packed layout.

methods.name: convert_image_channels_packed_to_width_packed
methods.description: Converts image tensor channels to width-packed layout.
